QuestInfo.name: Olive, A Criminal?
QuestInfo.0: How did Olive become a suspect? Ask #bAthena Pierce#k for more details.
QuestInfo.1:
If Olive is really the culprit, she needs to be caught. Search Ereve and see if you can find her.


#r(If you fail, you can forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Olive claimed that she's been framed. Is that true? She asked you to meet a man named Neinheart. See what you can learn from him.
